# PokieTicker source trace

This directory is a provenance record for the Phase 1 integration baseline.
It deliberately contains **no copied application source and no market database**.

- Upstream: <https://github.com/owengetinfo-design/PokieTicker>
- Locked commit: `c16b7e34e72c2d09bb50d7b3159fa5cd6697fd19`
- License at the locked commit: MIT, file SHA `a1f37e77d84916bfaec651800fc65fe7ee25fcca`
- License text: [`../../LICENSES/PokieTicker-MIT.txt`](../../LICENSES/PokieTicker-MIT.txt)
- Retrieval method: connected GitHub integration, 2026-08-11.

The legacy `pokieticker.db` held elsewhere in the preserved old project is a
historical snapshot only. It must not be shipped as a live market source, and it
is intentionally excluded from this repository and from this source trace.
